description: This source file handles the generation and queueing of Notify messages in a USP (Universal Service Platform) agent, including creation of various notification types such as ValueChange, ObjectCreation, ObjectDeletion, Event, OnBoard, and OperationComplete, as well as handling responses and generating unique message IDs.

methods.name: MSG_HANDLER_CreateNotifyReq_ValueChange
methods.description: Creates a Value Change Notify message with specified path, value, subscription ID, and response flag.

methods.name: MSG_HANDLER_HandleNotifyResp
methods.description: Handles incoming NotifyResponse messages, validates them, and stops retry attempts.

methods.name: MSG_HANDLER_CreateNotifyReq_ObjectCreation
methods.description: Creates an Object Creation Notify message for a specified object path and subscription ID.

methods.name: MSG_HANDLER_CreateNotifyReq_ObjectDeletion
methods.description: Creates an Object Deletion Notify message for a specified object path and subscription ID.

methods.name: MSG_HANDLER_CreateNotifyReq_OperCompleteSuccess
methods.description: Creates an Operation Complete (Success) Notify message with optional output arguments.

methods.name: MSG_HANDLER_CreateNotifyReq_OperCompleteFailure
methods.description: Creates an Operation Complete (Failure) Notify message with error code and message.

methods.name: MSG_HANDLER_CreateNotifyReq_Event
methods.description: Creates an Event Notify message with event name, output arguments, and subscription ID.

methods.name: MSG_HANDLER_CreateNotifyReq_OnBoard
methods.description: Creates an OnBoardRequest notification with agent details.

methods.name: MSG_HANDLER_CalcNotifyMsgId
methods.description: Generates a unique message ID for notify messages based on type and timestamp.

methods.name: CreateOperComplete
methods.description: Helper to create an Operation Complete Notify message with command and key.

methods.name: CreateNotify
methods.description: Dynamically creates a generic Notify message with specified type and details.

methods.name: AddObjCreation_UniqueKeys
methods.description: Transfers unique key parameters into an ObjectCreation message, destroying the original vector.

methods.name: OnBoardRequestMessageId
methods.description: Creates a unique message ID for onboard requests, including a counter and timestamp.
